text:
rory: opened a compact docs PR for structured-output migration + pragmatic SDK shims: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1210 — would love reviewers for the examples and the "fallbacks" section

kevin: scanning. quick decision needed: do we recommend a single canonical shape for new content or a small set? SDK owners want determinism.

rory: recommend one canonical top-level object for new docs: {"result_type": string, "result": object}. include a short appendix showing how to map older array/union envelopes into that shape.

anika: added TS & Python snippets and a normalize util. TS example: 
```ts
export function normalizeOut(x:any){ if(Array.isArray(x)) x = x[0]; if(typeof x==='string') try{ x = JSON.parse(x) }catch{} return x }
```

lisa: please add guardrails at top: prefer top-level object, single explicit tool_call when invoking external actions, avoid top-level anyOfs. short bullets only.

kevin: CI flagged a broken link: /docs/old/tool-invoke.md -> 404

ci-bot: link-checker: /docs/old/tool-invoke.md -> 404 (line 21)

anika: fixed links in a new commit to /docs/reference/tool-invoke.md and updated anchors. pushed.

rory: add a tiny troubleshooting section with pragmatic parse fallbacks for streamed/truncated outputs. example regex extractor and a safe JSON parse attempt. keep it marked as "best-effort".

lisa: added acceptance checklist for reviewers: streaming partial JSON, escaped/serialized arguments, and ensure SDK-friendly types in examples.

kevin: also include guidance on argument sizes — recommend serialized `arguments` < 8KB and include a small trimming helper for the SDK.

anika: added trimming helper and a tiny unit test that warns if args > 8KB.

ci-bot: docs precheck: snippet-permalink missing for /docs/sdk/snippets/tool_shims.md

rory: pushed permalink fix and a brief changelog entry. plan: merge if CI passes and no objections by Tuesday 16:00 PT. I'll notify Integrations when the site is rebuilt.

lisa: LGTM — left a wording nit.

kevin: LGTM after CI. thanks all.

anika: ack, watching CI.
